responsibility: Defines the primary target macros, data structures, and backend-wide configuration interface for GCC’s i386 and x86-64 targets. This header establishes ABI and ISA convenience macros, processor cost structures, machine_function layout, register and symbol flags, target defaults, backend constants, and many compile-time policies that other x86 source files and subtarget headers build upon, making it the central architectural header for the entire gcc/config/i386 module.
same_name_distinction: The central architectural header for the x86 backend, defining macros, structures, and backend-wide compile-time interfaces; unlike i386.cc it is declarative, unlike i386.md it contains no instruction patterns, and unlike i386.opt it is not an option-definition table.
